{"id":1863849784,"question_id":3334,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1766552085,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1863849784/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Apple Redistribution into Boxes","memory":"34 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumBoxes(vector<int>& apple, vector<int>& capacity) {\n        int boxes = 0;\n        sort(capacity.rbegin() , capacity.rend());\n        int sum = accumulate(apple.begin() , apple.end() , 0);\n\n        for(auto n : capacity)\n        {\n            if(sum <= 0) break;\n            sum -= n;\n            boxes++;\n        }\n    return boxes;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"apple-redistribution-into-boxes","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1384}
